comparability_notes.note: Every figure is from the 'Statement of Staff Utilization' in the Consolidated Revenue Fund Supplementary Schedules volume of the Public Accounts (statement marked Unaudited). The unit is full-time equivalents (FTEs) as defined by the statement's own sentence (see scope_note); no headcount figures appear on these statements, so none are recorded.

Scope sentence wording changes: 2000/01-2015/16 read '...whose salaries are paid directly by the Consolidated Revenue Fund.'; 2016/17 onward read '...whose salaries are paid directly by the General Fund.' The statement title stays 'Consolidated Revenue Fund Statement of Staff Utilization'. Whether this is a wording change only or a scope change is not stated on the statement.
Title printed as 'Statement of Staff Utilization' without the 'Consolidated Revenue Fund' line; from 2003/04 the title is 'Consolidated Revenue Fund Statement of Staff Utilization'.

STRUCTURE CHANGE in 2009/10. Through 2008/09 each row prints an Estimated (budget) and an Actual FTE figure plus a variance. From 2009/10 each row prints Actual only; estimates appear only as a single 'Total Estimates' line. Per-ministry budget FTEs after 2008/09 are not in this statement.

STRUCTURE CHANGE in 2004/05: the variance column's SIGN is reversed. 2000/01-2003/04 'Under (Over)' = Estimated minus Actual (overrun shown in parentheses). 2004/05-2008/09 'Variance Actual to Estimated' = Actual minus Estimated (underrun in parentheses). 2009/10+ 'Variance Actual to Estimates' = Total Actual minus Total Estimates.

Estimated column carries a footnote: 2000/01 and 2001/02 'The estimated numbers include transfers due to government reorganizations during the year.'; 2003/04-2006/07 and 2008/09 'Estimated column reflects government reorganization throughout year.' So the Estimated figures are restated, not necessarily the originally tabled budget FTEs. 2002/03 and 2007/08 carry no such footnote.

Row labels 2000/01-2007/08 are short forms (e.g. 'Forests', 'Attorney General'), not full ministry names. For 2000/01 only, the volume's 'Ministry Abbreviations' page (PDF page 3) maps each short form to a full name; that mapping is recorded in full_name_per_document_abbreviation_table. No such page was found in 2001/02-2007/08, so full names for those years are not recorded here. From 2008/09 rows print full 'Ministry of ...' names.

Rows that are not ministries appear alongside ministries: 'Legislation' (renamed 'Legislative Assembly' from 2016/17), 'Officers of the Legislature', 'Office of the Premier', 'Other Appropriations', 'Public Service Agency' (2021/22 onward), and in 2008/09 'Management of Public Funds and Debt' (printed blank). They are kept as printed and are part of the statement total.

Two rows ('Ministry of Small Business and Revenue', 'Management of Public Funds and Debt') are printed with blank cells in every column (confirmed on the rendered page). Recorded under rows_printed_without_figures, not as zero.

CONFLICT inside the source: the printed Actual rows sum to 33,215 but the printed total is 33,214; printed Under (Over) rows sum to 1,629 but the printed total is 1,630 (confirmed on the rendered page). Likely rounding; both figures kept as printed.

No 'Attorney General' or 'Public Safety and Solicitor General' row is printed; a 'Ministry of Justice' row is. From 2015/16 a separate 'Ministry of Public Safety and Solicitor General' row reappears beside Justice; from 2017/18 'Ministry of Attorney General' reappears. Ministry reorganizations mean rows with the same or similar names are not necessarily comparable across years.

Row printed as 'Housing' (no 'Ministry of'), confirmed on the rendered page. Also 'Ministry of Energy, Mines and Low Carbon Innovation' prints 1,476 and 'Ministry of Environment and Climate Change Strategy' prints 426, against 410/1,403 in 2020/21 and 446/1,143 in 2022/23. Values are recorded exactly as printed (confirmed on the rendered page); the source gives no explanation and no revision was found, so treat this year-on-year jump as unexplained.

The hosted statement is a REVISED report. Its footnote 1: 'This is a revised report issued on October 25, 2024 to correct a misalignment of staff utilization between five ministries as noted. "Total Actual" staff utilization remained the same as previously reported.' The five footnoted rows are Social Development and Poverty Reduction; Tourism, Arts, Culture and Sport; Transportation and Infrastructure; Water, Land and Resource Stewardship; Public Service Agency. The originally published figures were not obtained. Total Estimates 34,400 is printed for both 2022/23 and 2023/24.

'Legislation'/'Legislative Assembly' prints 350 in every year from 2006/07 (300 in 2003/04-2005/06) and equals its estimate in every three-column year from 2003/04. The statement does not say how this figure is derived.

Every year's per-row figures were checked against the printed total: all match except 2001/02 (see above). Values were extracted with pdftotext -layout and spot-checked on rendered pages for 2000/01, 2001/02, 2008/09 and 2021/22.

2023/24 figures as originally published, before the 25 October 2024 revision, for the five footnoted rows: not obtained.
Full ministry names for the short row labels in 2001/02-2007/08: no abbreviation table was found in those volumes. Not inferred.
Printed page numbers for 2000/01-2006/07: none found in the extracted text of the statement page (none visible on the rendered 2000/01 and 2001/02 pages). Locators give the PDF page instead.
Headcount: no headcount figures appear on any Statement of Staff Utilization, so none are recorded. Headcount series (e.g. BC Stats / Public Service Agency workforce profiles) not researched.

Scope in detail: the statement does not list which bodies are excluded (e.g. Crown corporations, school districts, health authorities, other entities outside the General Fund/CRF). Only the one-sentence definition is recorded; no exclusion list is inferred.
